about: Fly-down landing places. Curated fields: id, name, region, country, kind, latitude/longitude (where the person stands), view_toward (what the camera looks at past them, named in prompts), palette, note. Everything under 'coverage' is measured by scripts/build_place_catalog.py from the open datasets; nothing is downloaded for a place until it is chosen.
